name: expertum
description: Slash commands — /expertum:review, /expertum:research, /expertum:interview, /expertum:conduct, and /expertum:conduct-mvp — that fan a task out to read-only expert analysts: a single expertum:analyst sub-agent takes on one of 54 expert lenses served as data by the bundled MCP server (expertum_overview lists them, expertum_expert loads one), so the plugin adds one line to the agent roster, not 54. Review and research collect findings; interview walks the user through adaptive questionnaires to turn a vague idea into a pinned brief; conduct adds an autonomous plan->implement->expert-review loop in which the main agent does the coding; conduct-mvp runs the same loop scoped to the minimal implementation of the ask, deferring speculative hardening. Commands run inside the stock main agent (no default-agent override): with an argument they act on the given instructions, without one they act on the preceding conversation. Analysts write one Markdown report each into a per-run .expertum/<timestamp>--<name>/ folder via a bundled zero-dependency MCP server.
